findings.text: Every pf_active blocked row keeps the leading claim 'duplicate of pf_active_coil_XX_current' immediately beside the newly appended clause '... the chains do not corroborate it'. This is the same agreement claim the node removed from tf.json (line 4) because it was false there, and the node's own measurement shows it is equally unqualified for the coil chains: on E101173 nine coils' two chains correlate at r within 0.02 of zero, and on E060033 all ten do, so a flat 'duplicate' overstates how well the chains agree across the cached shots. The leading phrase is defensible read structurally (the blocked HiTe chain is an alternative source for the same semantic_id), but it now sits directly beside text that contradicts the measurement sense of the word, and unlike the TF row it is the only place that sense survives. The fragment says the node stopped 'calling the blocked chains duplicates' for tf only; consider stating the structural sense explicitly (e.g. 'alternative source for the same semantic') or dropping the word as was done for TF, so the two files use it consistently.

EF2's served evidence and blocked reason (line 34 and the EF2 served entry) say the E101173 excursion is 'far below the E101154 ... 2.66 kA'. Measured, the E101173 excursion is ~1.5 kA (LKAT peak 1496.1 A, HiTe 1449.1 A) against the E101154 served peak of 2659.7 A = 2.66 kA, so the excursion is about 56% of the E101154 figure -- below, but 'far below' overstates the gap. Minor wording; the underlying numbers are correct and re-derived.
